name: SIRT with Local Box Constraints
aliases: Dynamic SIRT with static initialization and segmentation constraints
definition: A variant of SIRT that uses initialization from previous time steps, global box constraints, and local box constraints derived from segmentation of a static reconstruction to constrain specific voxel types.
summary: SIRT with Local Box Constraints is a dynamic tomography algorithm that improves reconstruction quality by applying material-specific attenuation bounds derived from static segmentation masks.
